cases.content: The Barangay San Isidro council met on Tuesday. After reviewing the typhoon damage to the covered court, the members voted 6 to 1 to move the annual fiesta from January 21 to March 14, and asked the treasurer to release 45,000 pesos for repairs before the new date.
cases.raw: The Barangay San Isidro council met on Tuesday. After reviewing the typhoon damage to the covered court, the members voted 6 to 1 to move the annual fiesta from January 21 to March 14, and asked the treasurer to release 45,000 pesos for repairs before the new date.
